Final consonants: live and dead syllables

decks.name: Tones and vowel length
decks.desc: Sets of words that differ only in tone or vowel length: มา / ม้า / หมา, ใกล้ / ไกล, ข้าว / ขาว / เขา.

decks.name: Consonants: mid and high class
decks.desc: The mid-class and high-class letters, each with its traditional name word (ก ไก่, ข ไข่).

decks.name: Consonants: low class
decks.desc: The common low-class letters with their name words, and the sounds they share with high-class letters.

decks.name: Vowels and tone marks
decks.desc: One short word for each vowel shape and each tone mark.

decks.name: Greetings and politeness
decks.desc: Hello, thank you, sorry and the polite particles, for male and female speakers.

decks.name: People and family
decks.desc: Pronouns, kinship terms as "you" and "I", and family words.

decks.name: About me
decks.desc: Name, country, job, languages: introducing yourself with ชื่อ, เป็น and มาจาก.

decks.name: Numbers and money
decks.desc: Numbers to a million and prices in baht.

decks.name: Counting with classifiers
decks.desc: Noun + number + classifier for people, animals, books, cups, bottles and more.

decks.name: Food and drink
decks.desc: Dishes, tastes and the phrases for ordering and paying.

decks.name: Describing things
decks.desc: Describing words after the noun, colors, this and that, and comparisons.

decks.name: Time and days
decks.desc: Days, parts of the day, the Thai clock and time words.

decks.name: Directions and places
decks.desc: Places in town and the words for left, right, near and far.

decks.name: Getting around
decks.desc: Taxis, tuk-tuks, the BTS and tickets.

decks.name: Shopping and colors
decks.desc: Prices, bargaining politely, clothes and colors.

decks.name: Health and feelings
decks.desc: How you feel, what hurts, and the pharmacy.

decks.name: Questions and requests
decks.desc: Question words, yes/no questions and polite requests with ขอ and ช่วย.

decks.name: Traps for English speakers
decks.desc: False friends and word-for-word copies: เป็น with describing words, ฝรั่ง, ฟิต, อิ่ม, เผ็ด.

decks.name: Compliments
decks.desc: Everyday praise for food, work, skills and homes, and the modest Thai way to answer it. Cards are plain: men add ครับ, women add ค่ะ.

decks.name: Flirting
decks.desc: Words for flirting, phrases built from them, and how to ask someone out, say yes, or say no kindly, for male and female speakers.

decks.name: Top nouns
decks.desc: The most-used Thai nouns. Nouns never change: no plural, no article; the note gives the classifier.

decks.name: Top verbs
decks.desc: The most-used verbs. Thai verbs never change for person or time; time words do that work.

decks.name: Top adjectives
decks.desc: Describing words: they go after the noun and work like verbs, with no เป็น.

decks.name: Top adverbs
decks.desc: Very, already, still, often, here, now: mostly after the verb or at the end.

decks.name: Top pronouns
decks.desc: Beyond the basics in People and family: น้อง, หนู, ป้า as I and you, plus mine and yours, who, what and everyone.

decks.name: Top prepositions
decks.desc: ที่, ใน, บน, กับ, จาก, ถึง and the ข้าง… place words.

decks.name: Top conjunctions
decks.desc: And, but, or, because, if, so, when: joining ideas in Thai.

decks.name: Top words
decks.desc: Question words, this and that after the noun, numbers to twenty, yes and no, days and time words.

decks.name: Top classifiers
decks.desc: More classifiers for counting: noun + number + classifier.

decks.name: Top particles
decks.desc: The little words at the end of a sentence: คะ, นะ, สิ, เลย, ล่ะ, หรอก and more.
